news.titleEn: Fed holds rates steady despite concerns over inflation
news.conclusionEn: The Federal Reserve kept its benchmark rate at 3.75%-4.00%, but two officials dissented in favor of another quarter-point hike.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储维持利率3.75%-4%不变，两名官员投票主张加息
news.whyEn: The dissents signal a hawkish tilt; borrowers, bond markets and global currencies remain exposed to further US hikes as oil-driven inflation persists.
news.whyZh: 两票反对显示偏鹰立场，油价推高通胀下，后续加息风险仍压在借款人和债市身上
news.detailEn: The Fed paused after raising rates in September, saying inflation remains elevated and more information will guide its next move. Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack both voted for a 25 bps hike, Cook's first dissent since joining in 2022. Inflation has been above the 2% target for more than five years and has accelerated since September, partly due to the oil shock from the Iran war. With midterm elections on Nov. 3, markets are watching whether the Fed resumes hiking in December.
news.detailZh: 美联储在9月加息后本次按兵不动，声明称通胀仍处高位，需要更多数据再决定下一步。理事Lisa Cook和克利夫兰联储主席Hammack均投票支持加息25个基点，这是Cook自2022年上任以来首次投反对票。通胀已连续五年多高于2%目标，且受伊朗战争引发的油价冲击影响，9月以来还在加快。11月3日中期选举临近，市场关注美联储12月是否重启加息。

news.titleEn: Alphabet sinks 10% as it holds 2026 capex unchanged, expects significant increase in 2027
news.conclusionEn: Alphabet missed on both revenue and earnings for the first time in nearly four years and posted negative free cash flow, sending shares down more than 10% after hours.
news.conclusionZh: 谷歌母公司营收利润双双不及预期，盘后大跌超10%
news.whyEn: Negative free cash flow and soaring debt at a top AI spender raise fresh doubts about the returns on the AI buildout, weighing on the whole AI trade.
news.whyZh: AI投入最大户之一现金流转负、负债猛增，加剧市场对AI投资回报的担忧
news.detailEn: Revenue rose 25% to about $127.6 billion but missed estimates, and net income fell to $26.2 billion as losses on equity stakes reversed last quarter's windfall. Free cash flow was negative $9.07 billion, far worse than expected, while long-term debt jumped to $125 billion from $21.6 billion a year ago. Google Cloud was a bright spot, with revenue more than doubling to $30.7 billion. Management kept 2026 capex guidance of $195-205 billion and said spending will rise significantly in 2027, with reports pointing to over $300 billion.
news.detailZh: 第三季度营收增长25%至约1276亿美元但低于预期，因持有股权（如SpaceX、Anthropic）估值回落，净利润降至262亿美元。自由现金流为负90.7亿美元，远差于预期；长期债务从一年前的216亿美元飙升至1251亿美元。谷歌云是亮点，收入翻倍多至307亿美元。公司维持2026年1950亿至2050亿美元的资本开支指引，并表示2027年开支将大幅增加，可能超过3000亿美元。

news.titleEn: Microsoft stock jumps 4% as cloud growth drives earnings and revenue beat
news.conclusionEn: Microsoft beat estimates as Azure revenue grew 48% to over $33 billion, lifting shares about 4% after hours.
news.conclusionZh: 微软Azure增长48%，业绩超预期，盘后涨约4%
news.whyEn: Microsoft showed AI spending can turn into revenue while keeping free cash flow positive, contrasting sharply with Alphabet on the same night.
news.whyZh: 微软证明AI投入能转化为收入且现金流仍为正，与同晚谷歌形成鲜明对比
news.detailEn: Revenue rose 19% to $92.3 billion and adjusted EPS was $4.89, both above forecasts, with Azure now Microsoft's largest single business. CFO Amy Hood guided Azure growth of 49%-50% next quarter and said demand still exceeds supply. Capex and finance leases reached $45.2 billion, below estimates due to delayed third-party capacity, and are expected to accelerate in the second half. Free cash flow fell 27% to $18.6 billion but stayed positive.
news.detailZh: 营收增长19%至923亿美元，调整后每股收益4.89美元，均超预期，Azure已成为微软最大的单一业务。财务长Amy Hood预计下季度Azure增长49%-50%，并表示需求仍大于供给。资本开支加融资租赁为452亿美元，因第三方算力交付延迟而低于预期，预计下半财年将加速。自由现金流下降27%至186亿美元，但仍为正。

news.titleEn: Yemen's Houthis attack Saudi Arabia's largest oil refinery
news.conclusionEn: Iran-backed Houthis said they hit Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery with a ballistic missile, pushing oil prices higher on escalation fears.
news.conclusionZh: 胡塞武装称导弹袭击沙特最大炼油厂，油价应声走高
news.whyEn: Ras Tanura is a key hub for Saudi exports; with Brent already near $115, any supply hit feeds inflation and central bank hiking worldwide.
news.whyZh: 拉斯坦努拉是沙特出口枢纽，布伦特已近115美元，供应受扰将推高全球通胀
news.detailEn: The Houthis said the strike caused a fire at the 550,000-barrel-per-day complex, which includes a shipping terminal on the Gulf; Saudi authorities did not immediately confirm. The attack came amid reports that the US and Israel were preparing a new round of combat with Iran. Crude flows from the region had recovered to near pre-war levels, but the IEA chief warned energy markets are unlikely to normalize even next year. Further strikes on Saudi export terminals would be a major upside risk for oil prices.
news.detailZh: 胡塞方面称袭击导致这座日产能55万桶、配有海湾装运码头的炼化综合体起火，沙特当局未立即证实。此次袭击发生之际，有报道称美国和以色列正准备对伊朗发起新一轮军事行动。地区原油外运原本已恢复到接近战前水平，但国际能源署负责人警告能源市场明年也难恢复常态。若沙特出口码头再遭袭击，油价将面临显著上行风险。

news.titleEn: Iran sees only unacceptable ideas in latest mediation to end war, official says
news.conclusionEn: Qatar presented Iran with a new seven-day draft deal to end the war with the US and Israel, but a senior Iranian official dismissed it as unacceptable.
news.conclusionZh: 卡塔尔提出新停战方案，伊朗高官称其「不可接受」
news.whyEn: The war has disrupted global shipping and oil supply for eight months; the fate of diplomacy largely decides where energy prices and inflation go next.
news.whyZh: 战争已扰乱全球航运和石油供应8个月，谈判成败直接决定油价与通胀走向
news.detailEn: According to a source briefed on the talks, the plan lays out daily confidence-building steps for both sides over seven days, with several countries acting as guarantors, and Tehran was expected to respond by week's end. A senior Iranian official said Qatar had offered only ideas, not an offer, and that Iran would not show flexibility on the nuclear issue. Washington wants the nuclear program on the table from the start, while Tehran demands the US first lift its port blockade and oil sanctions. Reports that the US may resume strikes after the Nov. 3 midterms add urgency.
news.detailZh: 据知情人士透露，该方案在七天内为双方安排每日的互信措施，并由多国担任担保方，伊朗预计本周末前答复。但一名伊朗高级官员表示，卡塔尔提出的只是「想法而非方案」，伊朗在核问题上不会让步。美方要求一开始就把核计划纳入谈判，伊朗则坚持美国须先解除港口封锁和石油制裁。另有报道称美国可能在11月3日中期选举后恢复打击，使谈判更显紧迫。

news.titleEn: Bank of Canada governor says rate hike to 2.5% was needed in face of persistent inflation
news.conclusionEn: The Bank of Canada raised its policy rate by 25 bps to 2.5%, its first hike since 2023, and signaled more may follow.
news.conclusionZh: 加拿大央行加息25基点至2.5%，为2023年来首次加息
news.whyEn: It shows the oil shock is forcing central banks back into tightening, affecting Canadian mortgages and the global rate outlook.
news.whyZh: 说明油价冲击正迫使各国央行重回紧缩，影响加国房贷和全球利率预期
news.detailEn: Governor Tiff Macklem said the hike aims to stop high global oil prices from spreading into broader inflation, which rose to 3.1% in September. The bank had held at 2.25% for seven straight meetings and now says future decisions will be made one meeting at a time, with further hikes possible. It sharply raised its 2027 inflation forecast and sees no clear off-ramp to the Middle East conflict. The next decision is due on Dec. 9.
news.detailZh: 行长Tiff Macklem表示，加息是为防止高油价扩散为更广泛的通胀，加拿大9月通胀率已升至3.1%。此前央行已连续七次会议维持2.25%不变，现表示将逐次会议决策，不排除进一步加息。央行大幅上调2027年通胀预测，并认为中东冲突看不到明确出路。下一次利率决议定于12月9日。

news.titleEn: Israel election results: Netanyahu bloc wins 53 seats, opposition holds 48, Arab parties skyrocket
news.conclusionEn: With nearly all votes counted, Netanyahu's bloc has 53 seats and Eisenkot's 48, leaving neither with a path to a 61-seat majority.
news.conclusionZh: 以色列大选计票近尾声，内塔尼亚胡阵营53席，均未过半
news.whyEn: A hung parliament prolongs political uncertainty in Israel during an active regional war, with Arab parties emerging as potential kingmakers.
news.whyZh: 议会悬峙让战时以色列政局持续不明，阿拉伯政党或成关键造王者
news.detailEn: Likud remains the largest party with 26 seats, followed by Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar! with 21. Netanyahu's bloc of Likud and religious and far-right allies is eight seats short of a majority, while Eisenkot's bloc is 13 short. The two Arab parties nearly doubled their projected seats to 19, complicating coalition math for both sides. Weeks of coalition talks, or even another election, could follow.
news.detailZh: 利库德集团以26席保持第一大党，艾森科特领导的Yashar!党获21席。内塔尼亚胡联合宗教和极右翼盟友的阵营距过半数还差8席，艾森科特阵营则差13席。两个阿拉伯政党席位几乎较预期翻倍至19席，令双方组阁算盘都更复杂。接下来可能是数周的组阁谈判，甚至再次举行选举。

news.titleEn: China industrial profits post strongest growth in three months as tech boom widens economic divide
news.conclusionEn: Profits at China's large industrial firms rose 14.4% year on year in September, the fastest pace since June, driven by AI-related manufacturing.
news.conclusionZh: 中国9月规上工业利润增14.4%，AI制造业拉动明显
news.whyEn: It shows China's AI and commodity sectors are booming while consumer industries lag, a split that matters for global suppliers and markets.
news.whyZh: AI和资源行业火热而消费类行业疲软，这种分化影响全球供应链与市场
news.detailEn: Profits for January-September rose 15.5%, helped by Beijing's campaign against price wars and global AI demand. Optical fiber makers saw profits jump more than sixfold and semiconductor equipment makers over 50%, while higher commodity prices from the Iran war lifted miners. Factory-gate prices rose at the fastest pace since mid-2022. Consumer-facing sectors such as clothing, autos and furniture continue to lag amid weak domestic demand.
news.detailZh: 1至9月工业利润累计增长15.5%，受益于北京整治「内卷式」价格战和全球AI需求。光纤制造商利润增长超六倍，半导体设备制造商增长超50%，伊朗战争推高大宗商品价格也带动了矿业利润。出厂价格涨幅为2022年中以来最快。服装、汽车、家具等面向消费者的行业在内需疲弱下依旧落后。

news.titleEn: DoorDash's deal to buy Instacart coming as early as Thursday morning, sources tell CNBC
news.conclusionEn: DoorDash could announce a deal to acquire Instacart, reportedly valuing it at about $17 billion, as soon as Thursday.
news.conclusionZh: DoorDash最快周四宣布收购Instacart，估值约170亿美元
news.whyEn: The deal would combine two big US delivery platforms in online grocery and is likely to draw antitrust scrutiny.
news.whyZh: 将合并美国两大配送平台的生鲜业务，可能引发反垄断审查
news.detailEn: Talk of a deal began after The Information reported Instacart was exploring a sale and had spoken with Uber and DoorDash. Instacart shares rose about 4% after hours on the news. Buying Instacart would give DoorDash a much bigger footprint in grocery delivery, where it competes with Amazon and Walmart's fast-expanding same-day services. Analysts warn regulators could look closely at the companies' overlap.
news.detailZh: 此前The Information报道Instacart正在探讨出售，并与Uber和DoorDash有过接触。消息传出后Instacart盘后上涨约4%。收购Instacart将大幅扩大DoorDash在生鲜配送领域的版图，与亚马逊、沃尔玛快速扩张的当日达业务竞争。分析师提醒，两家业务高度重叠，监管机构可能会严格审查。

news.titleEn: Deutsche Bank profit tops third quarter forecast
news.conclusionEn: Deutsche Bank reported a 2% rise in third-quarter net profit, beating forecasts for a decline, and raised its full-year revenue outlook.
news.conclusionZh: 德意志银行三季度利润超预期增长，上调全年营收指引
news.whyEn: It is a read on European banks' resilience as high yields, AI worries and geopolitics weigh on investment banking.
news.whyZh: 反映高利率、AI担忧和地缘冲突下，欧洲银行业的抗压能力
news.detailEn: Net profit attributable to shareholders was €1.59 billion versus analyst expectations of €1.44 billion, helped by retail and corporate banking. Fixed-income and currency trading revenue fell 3% after a record year earlier, a smaller decline than US peers. The bank now expects group revenue above €33 billion this year. UBS and BNP Paribas report later this week, after HSBC disappointed investors.
news.detailZh: 归属股东净利润为15.9亿欧元，高于分析师预期的14.4亿欧元，零售和企业银行业务表现强劲。固定收益与外汇交易收入在去年同期创纪录后下降3%，降幅小于美国同行。银行预计今年集团营收将超过330亿欧元。在汇丰业绩令投资者失望后，瑞银和法国巴黎银行将于本周稍晚公布业绩。

businessTips.explanationEn: Capital intensity measures how much physical investment (factories, data centers, equipment) a business needs to generate each dollar of revenue, often shown as capex divided by revenue. Capital-light businesses can grow quickly with little cash, while capital-heavy ones must spend upfront and wait for returns. Shifting toward higher capital intensity changes a company's risk profile, cash flow and how investors value it.
businessTips.explanationZh: 资本密集度衡量企业每产生1元收入需要多少实体投资（工厂、数据中心、设备），常用资本开支除以营收来表示。轻资产企业用很少的现金就能快速增长，重资产企业则必须先投入、再等回报。当一家公司变得越来越重资产，它的风险、现金流和估值方式都会随之改变。
businessTips.exampleEn: Google used to be a capital-light software business, but AI data centers now push its annual capex above $200 billion, and this quarter its free cash flow turned negative. For a small business, choosing to lease equipment instead of buying it is a simple way to stay capital-light.
businessTips.exampleZh: 谷歌过去是典型的轻资产软件公司，如今AI数据中心让其年度资本开支超过2000亿美元，本季度自由现金流甚至转负。对小企业来说，设备选择租赁而非购买，就是保持轻资产的简单方法。

businessTips.explanationEn: Multi-homing means listing your products or services on several platforms at once rather than depending on one. It spreads platform risk: if one site changes fees, algorithms or gets acquired, your income doesn't collapse. The trade-off is extra admin work, so many sellers use tools that sync inventory and calendars across platforms.
businessTips.explanationZh: 多平台经营（Multi-homing）指同时在多个平台上架产品或服务，而不是依赖单一平台。这样能分散平台风险：某个平台改佣金、改算法甚至被收购时，你的收入不会一下子归零。代价是管理工作变多，所以很多卖家会用工具同步库存和日历。
businessTips.exampleEn: If DoorDash buys Instacart, a grocery shop that only sells via Instacart could face new fees or rules overnight. A short-stay host listing on Airbnb, Booking.com and a direct-booking site with a channel manager is applying the same principle.
businessTips.exampleZh: 如果DoorDash收购Instacart，只在Instacart上卖货的小超市可能一夜之间面临新费率或新规则。短租房东同时在Airbnb、Booking.com和自有直订网站上架，并用渠道管理工具同步日历，就是同样的思路。

businessTips.explanationEn: Free cash flow is the cash a company generates from operations minus its capital expenditures. Unlike accounting profit, it shows how much real cash is left to pay dividends, buy back shares, cut debt or fund growth. A company can report big profits yet have negative FCF if it is investing heavily, which forces it to borrow or dip into savings.
businessTips.explanationZh: 自由现金流是企业经营活动产生的现金减去资本开支后剩下的钱。与会计利润不同，它反映的是真正可用于分红、回购、还债或扩张的现金。一家公司即使账面利润丰厚，只要投资足够重，自由现金流也可能为负，这时就得借钱或动用存款。
businessTips.exampleEn: This quarter Alphabet earned $26 billion in net income but had negative free cash flow of about $9 billion, and its long-term debt surged; Microsoft, by contrast, stayed FCF-positive. Investors often compare FCF yield (FCF divided by market value) across companies to judge which is generating real cash for shareholders.
businessTips.exampleZh: 本季度谷歌净利润260亿美元，但自由现金流约为负90亿美元，长期债务也急升；相比之下微软的自由现金流仍为正。投资者常比较不同公司的自由现金流收益率（自由现金流除以市值），来判断谁在真正为股东创造现金。
